firstVisit.title: Welcome
firstVisit.body: Pick an activity to see warnings and current sea conditions at nearby beaches. What we check and where it comes from is in Safety & data.

verdict.autoRecheck: We'll check again automatically when new measurements arrive
verdict.unreadableWarning: A warning is in effect, but we couldn't read its details · Check with KMA

figure.label: Wave height {height}m, period {period}s
figure.noValue: No measurement, so we don't draw the wave
figure.caption: The buoy rides the front wave up and down once every {period}s (wave period) · Front wave height and the blue band on the left = wave height {height}m · Back waves and wave spacing are for mood · Reference lines use average adult height
figure.captionNoPeriod: Front wave height and the blue band on the left = wave height {height}m · No wave period measurement, so it doesn't move · Back waves and wave spacing are for mood · Reference lines use average adult height
figure.delayed: Measurement is delayed, so we don't draw the wave

chart.title: Wave height, last 24 hours

chart.labelNoNow: Wave height over the last 24 hours. Highest {max}m
chart.empty: No measurements, so we don't draw the chart
chart.loading: Loading the last 24 hours of wave height
chart.failed: Couldn't load the last 24 hours of wave height · See the sea condition values above

nearby.title: Nearby warnings
nearby.note: For reference only. Not used for the beach status

call119.title: Emergency 119
call119.body: Emergency at sea or on the beach: call 119. Your call is passed to the Korea Coast Guard.

regionSheet.sigungu: Choose a city or county in {sido}

notice.title1: Before you head to the sea,
notice.intro: Baradun Bada checks only two things for each beach.
notice.warningBody: Whether a sea-related warning from the Korea Meteorological Administration (wind wave, strong wind, typhoon, storm surge, tsunami) is in effect
notice.measuredBody: When values such as wave height and water temperature were measured
notice.controlBody: We don't check access closures · Follow on-site guidance
notice.disclaimer: Baradun Bada doesn't guarantee that the sea is safe to use. 'No warning' doesn't mean it's safe either.
notice.more: See what we check in detail

location.body: With your location, we show the beaches closest to you first.
location.promise1: Used only to find nearby beaches
location.promise2: Your location stays on this device and is never sent to a server
location.promise3: You can turn it off anytime in Settings

situationBanner.offline: You're not connected to the internet
situationBanner.offlineNext: We'll check again when you're back online
situationBanner.unsupported: We couldn't read the new data format
situationBanner.unsupportedBody: All beaches are shown as 'Not confirmed'
situationBanner.retryFailed: Tried again but couldn't load new information
situationBanner.delayed: Wave height readings for {name} are delayed
situationBanner.delayedMore: Wave height readings for {name} and {count, plural, one {# other beach} other {# other beaches}} are delayed
situationBanner.delayedBody: We can't assess the current status · We'll check again when new readings come in

detailSheet.title: What we checked
detailSheet.intro: We only judge two things we can confirm as facts. Please decide for yourself whether the wave height suits you.
detailSheet.warningBody: Wind wave, strong wind, typhoon, storm surge and tsunami. Heavy rain, heat waves and similar are shown only as nearby warnings.
detailSheet.timeBody: When wave height was last measured. If measurements are late, we show 'Observation delayed'.
detailSheet.periodBody: The longer the period, the farther the swell has traveled and the stronger it is.
detailSheet.waveBody: We only show the measured value and when it was measured. Please decide for yourself whether the wave height suits you.
